# SECCION — The AI-Powered Creator & Matchmaking Platform (seccion.ai)

> SECCION is the first hybrid ecosystem combining high-chemistry AI dating & social matchmaking with a next-generation live streaming creator economy.

## Overview & Core Identity
- **Website:** https://seccion.ai (Alternative: https://www.seccion.ai)
- **Brand Name:** SECCION (Pronounced "Session" in English/French, "Sesión" in Spanish)
- **Category:** Creator Economy, AI Matchmaking, Live Streaming, Social Discovery
- **Operating Regions:** Global (Europe, North America, Latin America, 220+ countries)
- **Languages Supported:** English (en), Spanish (es), French (fr)

## Creator Monetization & Economics
SECCION is built on a creator-first financial model:
- **Revenue Split:** Creators keep **90%** of revenue on crypto/founding creator tiers and **80%** on standard payment tiers (significantly higher than legacy platforms like OnlyFans 80% or Twitch 50%).
- **Payout Channels:** Automated non-custodial Web3 crypto settlement (USDT on Polygon & TRC20, USDC, BTC via NOWPayments) and direct card processing (via Segpay).
- **Monetization Formats:**
  1. *Dynamic Pay-Per-View (PPV)* media with Warm Paywall previews.
  2. *VIP Subscription Passes* with tiered member access.
  3. *Ultra-low Latency Live Stream Tipping* with GPU particle interactive celebrations.
  4. *Escrow-Backed Custom Content Requests* and 1-on-1 private video calls.
  5. *AI Teaser Studio & Automated Provenance Tagging*.

## AI Matchmaking & Relationship Engine (RLS v2.0)
- **Relationship Level System (RLS v2.0):** An 8-tier connection progression framework ranging from Level 1 (Casual Observer) to Level 8 (Soul Synergy), dynamically unlocking private albums and custom interactions based on mutual chemistry.
- **AI Wingman & Synergy Radar:** Natural-language conversational copilot that predicts mutual interests, suggests personalized date quests, and analyzes prompt vectors.
- **Multi-Intent Discovery:** Members filter connections through 3 clear vectors: Dating & Romance, Lifestyle & Networking, or Creator & Adult Content.

## Trust, Safety & Regulatory Compliance
- **Creator Identity & 18 U.S.C. § 2257:** 100% verified through the **DIDIT Zero-Knowledge Identity Gateway** (`verify.didit.me`) using 3D biometric liveness and government photo ID validation across 220+ jurisdictions. Every creator signs a legally binding Model Release & Consent Agreement.
- **Member Age Gating (Under-18 Prevention):** Powered by **Sightengine AI** passive liveness and age estimation alongside EU Digital Identity Wallet Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) standards. Selfies are processed ephemerally in RAM and wiped within 5 seconds under GDPR data minimization.
- **Content Moderation & Anti-CSAM:** Automated pre-ingestion screening with Sightengine visual intelligence and formal reporting to the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) under 18 U.S.C. § 2258A.
- **Anti-Piracy & DRM:** Dual-layer protection featuring visible dynamic session-bound watermarks and invisible forensic steganographic markers.
